name: usb_device_dfu_standalone
description: USB_Device/DFU_Standalone as ST ships it, with an empty application area, so it starts in DFU mode. It enumerates as ST's DFU device (0483:DF11, 'DFU in FS Mode') and then never answers SET_CONFIGURATION. Its usbd_conf.h sizes the static allocator for the MSC class (MAX_STATIC_ALLOC_SIZE 262 words, 1048 bytes), but the DFU class's handle is 1056 bytes with the USB device middleware CubeF4 pins (v2.11.4). USBD_DFU_Init's writes run 8 bytes past `mem` into `hpcd`, which the linker places right after it, and dev_status[4] (DFU_STATE_IDLE, 2) becomes the low byte of hpcd.Instance: the HAL's OTG base is 0x50000002 from then on, every access is two bytes off, and the status stage is never queued, so the host keeps seeing NAKs. A board built from these sources does the same. usb_device_dfu_fixed corrects that one size.
